import os
from datetime import datetime, date
import openpyxl

input_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/57090/1_57090_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/57090_0_98e9794c/1_57090_output.xlsx"

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

def get_year(value):
    if value is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(value, (datetime, date)):
        return value.year
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        # Excel serial date fallback
        try:
            return openpyxl.utils.datetime.from_excel(value).year
        except Exception:
            return None
    if isinstance(value, str):
        value = value.strip()
        for fmt in ("%Y-%m-%d", "%m/%d/%Y", "%d/%m/%Y", "%Y/%m/%d"):
            try:
                return datetime.strptime(value, fmt).year
            except ValueError:
                pass
        if len(value) >= 4 and value[:4].isdigit():
            return int(value[:4])
    return None

# Build mapping: shipping year -> set of unique Project IDs
projects_by_year = {}
for row in range(2, ws.max_row + 1):
    project_id = ws.cell(row=row, column=2).value  # Column B: Project ID
    shipped = ws.cell(row=row, column=3).value     # Column C: Shipped
    year = get_year(shipped)
    if project_id is not None and year is not None:
        projects_by_year.setdefault(year, set()).add(project_id)

# Fill only G2:K2 with the counts for the year headers in G1:K1
for col in range(7, 12):  # G:K
    header = ws.cell(row=1, column=col).value
    try:
        year = int(header)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        year = None
    ws.cell(row=2, column=col).value = len(projects_by_year.get(year, set())) if year is not None else None

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
